resources.string: Ordinary typing stays on this device. Only explicitly requested online AI sends Buffer source to your configured service. Buffer drafts clear when the keyboard closes or the input field changes. Buffer is disabled in password and private fields.
Pasted into Buffer. Insert when ready.
No clipboard text is available to paste.
Clipboard access is unavailable. Copy the text again and retry.
Tap Collect to save text on this device. Nothing is read automatically.
Tap an entry to add it to Buffer. Up to 40 entries; no cloud sync.
Clipboard text exceeds the 16 KiB limit. Copy a smaller selection.
Buffer is full. Insert or clear it first.
Candidate selections improve your local dictionary. Turning this off preserves existing learning. Private fields never learn. No full typing history is stored.
Private field — no learning or Buffer
Chinese unavailable. Tap Retry; English is available.
Text is retained. Free Buffer space or retry insertion.
